alchemist_shared_sample.label: Shared Sample
alchemist_shared_sample.description: Equip Shared Sample instead of Acid. Share one Acid reaction with the target and adjacent living characters without guaranteed damage.

rogue_blame_furniture.label: Blame the Furniture
rogue_blame_furniture.description: Equip Blame the Furniture instead of Wasn't Me. Mark an enemy to redirect its next attack toward adjacent furniture.

necro_stay_friend.label: Stay, Friend
necro_stay_friend.description: Equip Stay, Friend instead of Summon Skeleton. Its skeleton greets without pursuing.

wizard_through_shot.label: Through Shot
wizard_through_shot.description: Equip Through Shot instead of Blast. Hit a primary target and the first eligible target behind it.

blacksmith_sweep.label: Sweep
blacksmith_sweep.description: Equip Sweep instead of Hammer Time. Hit up to two adjacent opponents for 1 damage each.

recruit_blacksmith.label: Recruit the Hobby Smith
recruit_blacksmith.description: Recruit with Hammer Time, Try This, and the Try This and Hold standing orders.

blacksmith_learn_bonk.label: Learn Bonk and Taunt
blacksmith_learn_bonk.description: Equip Bonk and taunt instead of Hammer Time.

blacksmith_learn_acid.label: Learn Acid
blacksmith_learn_acid.description: Equip Acid instead of Hammer Time. The Mixologist's orders are not included.

recruit_bard.label: Recruit the Bad Bard
recruit_bard.description: Recruit with both songs and the Inspiring Melody and Hold standing orders.

recruit_rogue.label: Recruit the Daft Dodger
recruit_rogue.description: Recruit with Wasn't Me, Confusing Dodge, and the Confusing Dodge and Retreat standing orders.

recruit_necromancer.label: Recruit the Friendly Crypter
recruit_necromancer.description: Recruit with Summon Skeleton, Raise Dead, and the Make a Friend and Hold standing orders.

recruit_alchemist.label: Recruit the Mixologist
recruit_alchemist.description: Recruit with both bottles and the Make Rounds and Follow standing orders.

knight_rescue_line.label: Rescue Line
knight_rescue_line.description: Pull a friendly character exactly two tiles away one open tile toward the Knight without recoil.

knight_shield_wall.label: Shield Wall
knight_shield_wall.description: Equip Shield Wall instead of Reflecting aura. Block three open tiles with one shared HP. Guard places the first legal wall or waits.

knight_escort_order.label: Stay Close
knight_escort_order.description: Follow the closest other ally and stop adjacent.

knight_learn_bonk.label: Learn Bonk and taunt
knight_learn_bonk.description: Equip the Healer’s Bonk and taunt instead of Push.

teach_healer_blast.label: Teach the Healer: Blast nearest
teach_healer_blast.description: Equip the Caster’s Blast instead of Bonk. It can hit allies or obstacles; no Caster order or rewards are included.

healer_apply_padding.label: Apply Padding
healer_apply_padding.description: Equip Apply Padding instead of Heal. Give a patient a 2-point damage buffer, without healing.

healer_triage_order.label: Triage
healer_triage_order.description: Use equipped Heal or Apply Padding on the patient missing the most HP within 3 tiles, including the Healer. Wait if no legal patient is wounded.

wizard_ring_sparks.label: Ring of Sparks
wizard_ring_sparks.description: Deal 2 damage to all adjacent living characters, allies included.

wizard_learn_dodge.label: Learn Confusing Dodge
wizard_learn_dodge.description: Equip the Dodger’s Confusing Dodge instead of Pull.

song_weaving.label: Song Weaving
song_weaving.description: Switching between base songs on consecutive rounds echoes the previous song once after the current song.

bard_learn_push.label: Learn Push
bard_learn_push.description: Equip the Knight’s Push instead of Sonnet.

rogue_tripwire.label: Tripwire
rogue_tripwire.description: Hold the nearest eligible opponent within two tiles against its next voluntary movement. Forced movement still works.

rogue_learn_potion.label: Learn Healing Potion
rogue_learn_potion.description: Equip the Mixologist’s Healing Potion with its forecast weighted reaction.

necro_grave_bell.label: Grave Bell
necro_grave_bell.description: Repel the nearest other character one tile if clear, friend or foe.

necro_learn_melody.label: Learn Inspiring Melody
necro_learn_melody.description: Equip the Bard’s Inspiring Melody. Laughter immunity applies; Song Weaving is not included.

alchemist_throw_samples.label: Throw Samples
alchemist_throw_samples.description: Delegate equipped Acid or Shared Sample against the nearest hostile in reach.

alchemist_etching_paste.label: Etching Paste
alchemist_etching_paste.description: Deal 2 acid damage at range 1 with the normal forecast reaction.

order_knight_advance.label: Advance and Push
order_knight_advance.description: Pursue and Push the nearest opponent.

order_healer_aggressive.label: Pursue and Bonk
order_healer_aggressive.description: Pursue and Bonk the nearest opponent.

order_wizard_pull_petition.label: Pull the Nearest
order_wizard_pull_petition.description: Pull the nearest legal character, even a friend, and suffer recoil.

order_rogue_blame.label: Pass the Blame
order_rogue_blame.description: Delegate equipped Wasn't Me or Blame the Furniture.

order_necro_raise.label: Raise Dead
order_necro_raise.description: Raise the nearest legal corpse, with ties in encounter order.

order_bard_sonnet.label: Healing Sonnet
order_bard_sonnet.description: Sing Sonnet to a random eligible opponent.

order_smith_pursue.label: Pursue with Hammer Time
order_smith_pursue.description: Pursue and use equipped Hammer Time or Sweep.

order_knight_rescue_petition.label: Rescue on Standing Orders
order_knight_rescue_petition.description: Use equipped Rescue Line on the nearest legal ally.

order_knight_bonk_petition.label: Knight's Bonk
order_knight_bonk_petition.description: Use equipped Bonk on the nearest legal opponent.

order_wizard_sparks_petition.label: Ring on Standing Orders
order_wizard_sparks_petition.description: Use equipped Ring of Sparks, even beside friends.

order_rogue_potion_petition.label: Dodger's Potion
order_rogue_potion_petition.description: Give equipped potion to the most injured legal patient.

order_alchemist_paste_petition.label: Paste on Standing Orders
order_alchemist_paste_petition.description: Use equipped Etching Paste on the nearest legal opponent.

order_alchemist_pull_petition.label: Mixologist's Pull
order_alchemist_pull_petition.description: Pull the nearest legal character, even a friend, and suffer recoil.

order_smith_bonk_petition.label: Smith's Bonk
order_smith_bonk_petition.description: Use equipped Bonk on the nearest legal opponent.

order_smith_acid_petition.label: Smith's Acid
order_smith_acid_petition.description: Use equipped Acid on the nearest legal opponent.

alchemist_learn_pull.label: Learn Pull and recoil
alchemist_learn_pull.description: Equip the Caster’s Pull with its full recoil and knockdown.
